event.text:
Updated `compose/ui` stories so defaults are uncontrolled and removed extra controlled variants.

### What I changed

- Removed `Controlled` stories from:
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Diagram.stories.tsx`
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Design.stories.tsx`
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Model.stories.tsx`
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Scene.stories.tsx`
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Kit.stories.tsx`

- Converted default stories to uncontrolled where they were controlled:
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Vector.stories.tsx`
    - `Default` now uses `defaultVector`
    - removed `Uncontrolled` and `PartialAxisControl` (both were redundant/controlled-focused)
  - `compose/ui/.storybook/stories/Vec.stories.tsx`
    - switched from `vec` to `defaultVec` in story args
    - removed local `useState` wrappers so stories are uncontrolled

- Cleaned up related imports/comments in those files (e.g. removed unused React/useState/type imports and updated summary headers).

- Verified lint status for edited files: no linter errors reported.
